name: Modern Construction Management
description: Introduction to construction projects, stakeholders, phases in a project, Project selection using time value of money concept, Project planning and network analysis-PERT, CPM, Precedence Diagram Method, LOB method, Resource scheduling, Time -Cost monitoring and control using S-curve with earned value analysis, Risk management, Construction quality and methods, Safety management in construction, Introduction to lean practices and Integrated Project Delivery, Introduction to agile project management.
